en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph showing a wide river cutting through a rural, hilly landscape. There is an unfinished or partially constructed bridge crossing the river, with visible bridge piers and cables but no completed deck. There are some boats on the water and telegraph or electrical poles in the foreground. Sparse trees and cultivated land are visible in the foreground, while wooded hills frame the river in the background. The handwritten text 'Puente Deume' is faintly visible at the top, and a small printed mark 'Biblioteca de Galicia' is at the bottom left.
